scope: Cross-build single-owner Vercel Sandbox start hardening for preferred PR781 lane

preferred_product_lane_observed.head: 7f3cac7e70f693199bd89cd9eec5a937694341c1
preferred_product_lane_observed.current_local_claim: atomic wx marker under build-instance os.tmpdir
preferred_product_lane_observed.known_limit: does not by itself establish exclusion across physically separate Vercel build instances

facts: Named sandboxes have a unique name within a project.
Sandbox.create accepts a name and a persistent flag; persistence defaults true and can be disabled.
Sandbox.getOrCreate is documented as idempotent for named sandboxes.
The upstream @vercel/sandbox changelog records getOrCreate support before version 2.9.2, so the pinned lane is in the supporting series.

candidate_mechanism.name: EXACT_HEAD_NAMED_EPHEMERAL_SANDBOX_SINGLE_OWNER
candidate_mechanism.proposal: Derive a deterministic provider-level sandbox name from exact source head/deployment contract and create it as non-persistent. Let the provider project-level unique-name constraint, rather than only a process-local tmp marker, arbitrate concurrent starts. Preserve fail-closed handling for duplicate/conflict outcomes and delete/stop bounded state after execution.
candidate_mechanism.benefit_if_supported: Could prevent two separate Vercel build instances for the same exact admitted execution identity from independently starting duplicate Sandboxes while retaining the build-internal-only execution surface.

strongest_counterhypotheses: A same-name concurrent create may not provide the exact atomic conflict semantics assumed by the SDK client.
A non-persistent named Sandbox may still leave name metadata or delayed cleanup that blocks legitimate fresh independent replication.
getOrCreate/resume semantics could accidentally reintroduce state reuse, violating fresh exact-state acceptance if used instead of create-only fail-closed semantics.
Provider name scope or OIDC project resolution may differ from the current build's intended project identity.
falsifier: Only after Vercel build capacity returns, use an authorized isolated build-internal Vercel test to exercise two same-identity create attempts plus stop/delete/recreate behavior. Require exactly one fresh Sandbox session to start concurrently, deterministic conflict/fail-closed behavior for the loser, no resumed stale filesystem state, and successful later fresh recreation after bounded cleanup.
reason_not_executed: Current exact PR781 Vercel preview/build is rate-limited before Sandbox creation; no local/VPS/self-hosted substitute is admissible for this provider-semantic discriminator.
entityos_impact: Coordination hardening only. It does not establish Bytes, EntityOS build/runtime, artifact, or whole-machine PASS.
next_step: Keep PR781 unchanged on this point until the provider-semantic discriminator can run in Vercel; if confirmed, integrate provider-level unique-name ownership without persistent/resumed state and rerun the full exact-head EntityOS batch.
